'''Graak''' was a trickster [[Deity/Legends|spirit]] of the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Species/Legends|species]] who rewarded clever [[Hunting/Legends|hunters]] by positioning wild game in their path. Graak came to be honored by hunters, and Ewoks would name their [[Wokling/Legends|children]] after him,<ref name="GCG" /> such as [[Graak|the warrior]] from [[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village]].<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Endor Limited|cardname=Graak}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Graak was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' which was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
